key_concepts: Heat is a transfer of energy due to temperature difference
Heat flows from higher to lower temperature regions
The SI unit of heat is the joule
Temperature is the degree of hotness or coldness of an object
Temperature measures average kinetic energy of particles
The SI unit of temperature is the Kelvin
Insulators have low thermal conductivity and reduce heat transfer
Conductors have high thermal conductivity and facilitate heat transfer
Heat transfer occurs through conduction, convection, and radiation
Heat transfer continues until thermal equilibrium is reached
Metals are good thermal conductors while wood and plastic are thermal insulators
